info.title: Contact Management
info.description:
Steps to get the mmApiKey ⤵️

- Step 1 - Go to the settings page. 
- Step 2 - Click on API keys.
- Step 3 - You would see a pre-made default API key for your account. You can use that or create a new API key by clicking on Add New API Key button. 
- Step 4 - Click on Show API Key to view the API key.
- Step 5 - Copy the API Key and paste it into your system.

post.description:
1. The bulk add to  list API provides you the ability to add multiple contacts to a list in one API call. 
2. There is a limit of adding 100 contacts in a single API call.
3. If the contact already exists, API updates the existing contact properties in the system or else a new contact is created in the system. 
4. If some contacts are not imported successfully. Error for individual email id will be sent in the response payload.
5. You can only make 1 call to the API at a time. So, if you are trying to make parallel API calls, you will receive an error.

> Please note - contacts added to a list via the `/addToList/Batch` API will not get enrolled to the journey (where trigger is set to contact added to a list ). You will have to use `/addToList` API to enroll users to the journey.

get.description:
Retrieve the following data of a contact using the email address :

- email address
- unique identifier of the contact
- data object with contact properties as key:value pairs
- blocked status
- blockedReason (will be present only if the contact is blocked)
- unsubscribed status
- unsubscribedReason (will be present only if the contact is unsubscribed)
- unsubscribed email types

Note: Enter email address (of the contact) in the request URL.
